content.label: The app is frozen and no longer works,  I do have a paid subscription. I am very disappointed!

Love this app and it worked really well before the latest IOS update. Since the update it will not load any of my metrics, I just get stuck on a loading screen indefinitely. I uninstalled the app and reinstalled it but now the app is stuck on the welcome screen. It prompts me to click an arrow to continue which I do but then nothing happens and the screen becomes frozen. 

Overall very disappointing. I understand it’s expected to experience some bugs with an update but in this case the app is completely unusable which is extremely disappointing as a premium user.

When I started following the app guidance, I stopped getting frequent small injuries caused by the lack of appropriate recovery. Also this app really helps me to avoid overexercising which triggers my migraines. It supports stable progress in my fitness journey.

Gentler Streak is seriously great for people who don’t want to exercise intensely, and gives us feedback of resting or pushing more effort to their body! 

Just one more thing for disability people who use Gentler, we need one more workout, and that is wheelchair basketball! It will make the app more accessible! Please and thank you! 🙏

J’appréciais que Gentler Streak ne me pousse pas à performer mais me laisse faire les choses à mon rythme sans culpabiliser. Avec la mise à jour, le widget de la forme cardiaque est extrêmement agaçant. Il me force à aller marcher pour se mettre à jour alors que je dois réduire mes marches pour régler une douleur aux pieds. Je fais plein d’autres exercices qui compensent et je n’ai pas besoin de faire de marches ou de courir pour être en forme. Je me moque totalement que les données de ce widget ne soient pas à jour. Arrêtez de me harceler avec ça!

This app is for iPhone / Apple Watch users. I made the switch to a Garmin from an Apple Watch and the usability of this app has suffered tremendously. 

The flow is now: Garmin Watch -> Garmin Connect -> Apple Health -> Gentler Streak. 

I’ve paid for the app in full, I’m not on a subscription. If I had known Garmin wasn’t fully integrated I would not have purchased.

This app is incredibly helpful. 

I have osteoporosis. 
As a 76 year woman I have no intention of accepting this diagnosis. With this app I am walking/running, and balancing my exercise with recovery days. 

Using Gentler Streak, I have lost 30 pounds since September 2025.

Down from 170 to 140. 
I’m 5 feet 6 inches
I have a BMI of 22. 
My visceral fat score is 9. 
10 is the baseline. 
My muscle mass has increased as my fat has decreased. I look fit and trim. But most of all I have encouraging and supportive messages that guide me towards recovery and safe exercise. 
In a year I will have a scan to determine my bone density. Stay tuned.

I’m loving this app and just renewed my (very reasonable) yearly subscription. The exercise tracking options are diverse and it monitors your health data to suggest whether today is a day to push or a recovery day. As someone who can overdo it and injure herself, this is great.

After over a year, the Gentler streak App is still my favourite: it takes a wholistic view of my health, recognizes the importance of balance in maintaining health; and with my permission, it monitors other health metrics from Apple Health. The “gentler streak activity path” guides my day-to-day exercise path over multiple days, letting me know when to ramp my activities up or down. It’s like my personal exercise coach. Kudos to the team that created this app!

Keeping things simple.  I like that.  Understated.  Yes.  Motivating - that, too.  This app punches above its weight, and does so with a sense of humour. But it’s very effective.  My go-to “fitness-tracker”.  Operated from my wrist, but I review trends on my phone.  Regularly updated. “Recommend!”

Love this app, and I use it every day. It gives me the details I need, sleep, vitals, and amazing detail on my workouts. I love that I can get an overview for a week, month or year. Plus a weekly recap which I love to see pop up. If you want to rest just click the status you need, sick, injure or rest. And hey the little guy is so cute, love him. Not sure his name!

I lived a very sedentary lifestyle and I decided to make a change. 

My fitness goal was modest, just incorporate daily activity and live a more active life. 

Gentler streak was an excellent tool, both in having an extensive list of workout activities and in the way it showed my progress. 

I particularly liked the concept of the activity path.  With that, I was able to see when I needed to do a little more and as importantly when I needed to slow down. 

Since starting my fitness journey 3 years ago I have managed to be active almost every day. 

The development team is responsive and issues were promptly resolved. 

I credit gentler streak with providing me with the impetus to get moving and to persist. 

Highly recommended!

I have been using Gentler Streak for a year or more now. I think of it as my personal daily health assistant. I like that it guides me gently in areas of exercise and sleep, two things I like to keep on top of. I’m enjoying the feedback and am finding it very helpful.

I have been using this app for about a year now and love it. Excellent interface and native activity tracking. All my other fitness apps feed into it nicely to keep an overall view of my training. Highly recommended for anyone that wants a balanced app that considers training load and recovery.
Great app!!
This app really helps me manage my chronic illness. It helps me see when I need to take it easy, or when it’s okay to push myself a little harder. I’m so happy I found this app.

title.label: A Habit App I Confidently Recommend as a Coach

content.label:
I’ve really been enjoying the Gentle Streak app—it’s been genuinely helpful in keeping routines and habits simple, realistic, and consistent. The interface is intuitive, and the overall approach feels supportive rather than overwhelming, which I truly appreciate.

I also want to acknowledge how generous the Gentle Streak team has been. They provided me access to the app, along with bags, stickers, and wrist pockets, which was unexpected and very kind. Their generosity and support genuinely stood out.

As a coach, I value tools that help people stay consistent without adding pressure, and Gentle Streak does exactly that. It aligns well with practical, real-life wellness, and I’m happy to recommend it to clients and colleagues.

Reasonably priced. 
I really like that it accounts for your quality of sleep and encourages you to rest when you’re over worked or recovering. It’s the first fitness app that I feel I can take a break (vacation/sick/injury) without the constant aggressive notifications telling me to get back to working out.

Honestly the best purchase I make every year. I was going through a burn out and it help me in ways I could never describe. If you’re thinking of subscribing to something similar and need true body readiness measures, this is it.

This app is very motivating. Too often I have overdone my fitness, hurt myself and then quit. This motivates me to watch that I don’t over do things allowing me to be consistent with my fitness journey.  Consistency wins.
I love this app. It is one of a kind. I cannot find a comparable app. I love that I can track my life. I get great insights into my sleep and exercise habits

I’ve been using this app for more than two years now and learned so much about my body and its ability to recover. The result is I am not just “being active”, I’m being active at the right time, in the right way with an approach that fits who I am and where I am. Sleepless night? Gentler gets it. Sick? That too. Recovering from being sick, yup. Plus, a kind approach that feels more like encouragement than boot camp - just my cup of tea.

title.label: Good for people who push too hard

content.label: This app has helped me dial back my training from extreme zone 5 to a more manageable zone 2 and 3. My Apple Fitness is always pushing me to go harder this app encourages appropriate rest and recovery. I did pay for premium but not sure the benefits hiding behind the pay wall are worth the money. I haven’t really explored the features completely. I find it easier to use when exercising than my other tracking apps and like how it monitors my heart rate on my watch so I can clearly see when my heart rate is getting too high. It also has an amazing gps tracker that shows me my xc ski route/mileage. I’m looking forward to using it in the summer for paddling and am hoping it will track my paddling route/mileage as Apple Fitness doesn’t. So far I’m pleased with the functionality, ease of use and the benefits for my mind and body.
Love the app and all its features.  It’s a perfect companion for someone who wants to take care of their health.

title.label: A Great and Compassionate Fitness App

content.label: I personally don’t make use of a lot of the metrics, I’m more of a casual fitness girl, but I adore the simple and light UI that makes it easy to know how I’m doing for the day or week. And it’s easy to pick up again when I have off days.

L’application idéale pour ma mise en forme. 
Merci!

title.label: To simple. To expensive. Nothing new.

content.label:
Very simple. Very expensive.
Honestly, it’s a nice-looking app, but that’s it. There’s absolutely nothing new that you can’t already find in Apple’s own Health app or in other, much more complete apps that cost half the price. I paid for the annual plan with a discount, but I regret it because I feel like I get very little for the cost. I don’t recommend it.
L’app ne s’ouvre plus?
If you have any other type of wearable, you can sort of deduce the information that comes from this app. It’s also often inaccurate in my opinion. Save your money.

I have MECFS and struggle with pacing, especially with exercise — I usually end up giving myself post exertional malaise if I’m not extra careful (PEM). I was excited that this app boasted it was designed for chronic illness and pacing, and I’m pretty disappointed. 

I have two apps including this one that measure HRV, heart rate, recovery, etc. to help me use metrics to guide my pacing and decide if I should workout or stay in bed (or something in between). My other app always clocks my changes in these metrics and warns about systemic exertion or distress. This app ALMOST ALWAYS still tells me to workout. For those who don’t know, working out during PEM can cause mitochondrial damage, so this app— in my opinion — should not be in charge of anyone’s pacing or health. 

It’s a good start. It’s got a cool design and it syncs nice with the watches, etc. but the main purpose of helping chronically ill individuals take back control of their health and activity is defeated when the app is encouraging us to workout when our bodies are producing metrics that clearly say we shouldn’t, and the app can’t read that accurately. If anyone was using this solely, and trusted it completely, they could risk further mitochondrial damage and disease progression with the inaccuracies I’ve been facing. 

Even worse, the longer I used the app, the worse it got.

Dev feedback: camera HRV/HR reader in the morning in place of missing or bugged sleep data — or for extra confirmation
Une belle app, facile à comprendre et vraiment j’adore!🫠
Le problème c’est le prix trop élevé. Merci de faire des offres irrésistibles à ceux qui aiment votre travail.
I really love this app! It’s a really holistic way of viewing exercise and I’m grateful for that!  I would looove to see steps be able to be show on the apple watch though!

title.label: An App that Understands My Body

content.label: This app has completely changed the way I understand my body. Gentler Streak helps me recognize when to push and when to rest, based on real recovery signals—not just motivation. It’s beautifully designed, easy to use, and gives me clarity on my physical limits in a way no other app has. A must-have for anyone who cares about long-term health and balanced progress.

title.label: Great workout/health monitor app with a few flaws

content.label:
It is a great app to log a variety of workouts. It tells you how much you should workout and when it's too much, depending on the days and energy spent to that point. I really like it mainly for all the stats and customization you have. It also has steps count and sleep monitoring.

Although, it has its flaws :

- Half of the time, the last activity I did is not in the list when I click on the Go Gentler button in the iPhone app and I have to select it on my apple watch. Not super convenient.

- At times, the apple watch mirroring to the phone appears in the app but when I click on the mirror button at the bottom it doesn't do anything. From time to time, the mirroring just doesn't work at all when starting a workout. 

Without these flaws, the app would be a breeze to use. It's still a really good tool for workout.

The periods where it doesn't capture the heart rate have increased. I've tried it with the native app and there are no periods without capturing the heart rate. Is this a problem with the AW or with this app?

I wanted to like this app. And at one point I felt like I was forcing myself to like it. I don’t know if it was just a bad year of getting sick a lot and breaking my streak, but the app was always telling me I was overreaching even if I just do my normal routine. I found myself not looking at it because I found it more discouraging than anything else. I also reached out to customer service at one point with an issue about app on the Apple Watch and they told we never had that issue before and told me to just delete and redownload the app. I did so several times. It did eventually fix itself, but I found the comment they do not have that issue very unhelpful and almost gaslighting.
Only works if you have a watch on. It won’t track your distance without it

This app is a bit all over the place. It considers a 5 min walk to be pushing it, and a 1hr Pilates class once a week is overreaching… but I feel totally fine and my heart rate is good. 
I’m in fairly good health with a high vo2max, good SpO2 and I eat well with adequate sleep. Not exactly sure why this app doesn’t appreciate a good workout or simple walk. I can’t really seem to control the settings too much. Considering deleting the app as it doesn’t seem helpful.

I paid for premium but the app does not provide any new information about your training on top of what you get from the health app. If you want to improve your fitness look elsewhere.

Installed as part of a lower stimulation phone effort. Uninstalled before I could see the value of the app because it sent me constant upsell/deal/fake urgency notifications totally out of line with my goal. Burned my trust in 3 days.

title.label: Gentler Streak on Apple Watch Ultra

content.label:
I've been using the **Gentler Streak** health app on my Apple Watch Ultra for a few months now, and I must say, it's been a game-changer for my fitness routine. This app takes a compassionate approach to fitness, focusing on maintaining a healthy balance between activity and rest.

**User-Friendly Interface**: The app's interface is clean and intuitive, making it easy to navigate and track my progress. The visuals are engaging and provide a clear overview of my daily activity levels.

**Personalized Recommendations**: One of the standout features of Gentler Streak is its personalized workout recommendations. The app takes into account my activity levels, rest days, and overall health to suggest daily workouts that are just right for me. This ensures I'm not overexerting myself and helps prevent burnout.

**Rest and Recovery**: Unlike other fitness apps that push you to hit your activity goals every day, Gentler Streak emphasizes the importance of rest and recovery. It encourages rest days and provides insights into how much rest I need based on my activity patterns. This holistic approach has helped me stay motivated without feeling guilty for taking a break.

**Sleep Tracking**: The app also includes sleep tracking, which has been incredibly helpful. It provides detailed insights into my sleep quality, including the amount of restorative sleep I get each night. This has helped me understand my sleep patterns better and make necessary adjustments to improve my overall well-being.

**Overall Experience**: My experience with Gentler Streak has been overwhelmingly positive. It's not just a fitness tracker; it's a comprehensive health companion that supports my journey towards a healthier lifestyle. The app's friendly reminders and encouraging messages keep me motivated, and the focus on sustainable fitness is exactly what I needed.

I highly recommend Gentler Streak to anyone looking for a balanced and supportive approach to fitness. It's perfect for those who want to stay active without feeling overwhelmed by extreme workout demands.

title.label: Good app— adhd girlies will enjoy

content.label:
Really good app

Too broke to get the full version but the free version still tells you a lot of good info! 

The integration with the Apple Watch is so good at reminding me to log my daily walk commutes and helps me feel better for counting them as exercise instead of just the gym!

The little information packets also are really informative and the language/tone used in the app doesn’t make you feel guilty for not keeping up with it.

As soon as I got an Apple Watch I discovered this app, and it has changed how I feel about my body and my attitudes toward exercise. I used to think I needed to push through, that I was never doing enough. I am much healthier, balanced, and actually more fit in a sustainable way since using Gentler Streak, and I feel more free to incorporate a wide variety of exercise into my life. Thank you so much for making this app!!
